THE STUDIO / ABOUT US

A different kind
of after-school club.

For us, creativity is what happens when curiosity meets a little extra effort. Even after the day is done.

01 / WHY AFTER HOURS?

Built on curiosity.
Not convention.

The best ideas don’t always arrive on a schedule. Sometimes they start as a sketch in the margins, a conversation after class, or a project you can’t stop thinking about.

After Hours is a student creative studio concept built around that energy. It brings brand design, photography, and video together for local businesses, independent creators, and campus communities.

The approach is simple: listen carefully, explore with purpose, and make work that feels like the people behind it.

01

Ask better questions.

Start with the people, purpose, and problem. A strong idea begins with understanding the brief.

02

Make it mean something.

Every type choice, image, and edit should help tell the story. Good looks are only the beginning.

03

Stay open. Get better.

Share early, welcome feedback, and refine the details. The first draft is a starting point.

ah.

BEHIND THE PROJECT

One student. A lot of possibilities.

After Hours was created for the AI Web Design Hackathon—a hands-on exploration of design, code, and responsible AI collaboration. The studio and featured work are concepts, with room to grow into something real.

YOUR IDEA. OUR NEXT LATE NIGHT.

Let’s make
something good.
